content: Garava dadda riiga

Kaa gwiya tsagaan kǝ Yesu dlaɓ tǝ ghaiya dǝlva Galili. Uudahi faɗarvǝt da tǝghǝr kǝ iina ndzar ba ɗyaka, aɗabad kwaha, iin wa fǝghara daas kǝ iin damma pɛrrayiu cihuran ma vakaiya. Dzahava uudaha ar ghacigan tǝ ghaiya gardza zaagha.
Kaa tsagtǝrtsag kǝ iin kǝ dǝgitah baɗyak tǝdvad garava. Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra,
“Cinngamcinnga, dadda uusǝg dal da riig ma guhaana.
Riig nǝ iina, kaa ɓalgalɓalǝg kyalma hulf da tǝ ɗuula, kaa sagau kǝ ɗiikah ar caggu.
Kyalma hulfah ɓalal dat caccahǝlawa vakavaki maay haay ɗyak biya. Kaa laghǝra sagal kǝ iitǝr ba watswatsa aɗaba maay haay ɗyak vaakwahiin biya
Ghut ba faciya, kaa fuugalfuug kǝ hǝiy ghulala, aɗaba badi bi kǝ tlali biya.
Kyalǝm ɓalal damma takka, kaa ghubargaraa ghubarg kǝ takka kaa zǝgǝtzǝg kǝ takka tsarva kǝ ya zǝra.
Kyalǝm ɓalal dat haay marawa. Kaa laghǝra sagala kǝ iitǝr ar ghubaran ba marawa, kyalǝmaan yaa zǝr kulhǝkǝrɗ-kulhǝkǝrɗ, kwatlǝrǝn kul ǝngkwah ǝngkwaha, kyalǝm dlaɓa zǝr dǝrmǝk-dǝrmǝka.”
Tǝhala kwaha amaa, “Baɗǝm dadda kwad dǝ hyimya cinngaana aa cinnga.”
Dǝgiti tuuk vakai garava dadda riiga
Ma sarta kwandza cǝhurgan nǝ Yesu ba daghwvǝna, kaa ghalgaan kǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝlawa tar buwa ard lii gatǝgaan maa tagtǝr kǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai garavǝna.
Aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Hayakuranthaig nǝ uud am sǝra kǝ dǝgiti shǝɓashǝɓan tǝghǝr kǝ tlǝkǝssǝra Daadamazhigǝla. Lii maay makuram biya, aanji kwar kǝ dǝgita taggǝvtǝr bad garava.
Iin wa nǝ iina,

content.text: “ ‘Aanji ar ba vazǝgaana, ar nǝghǝga biya.
Aanji ar cinngaana, ar nǝghǝgaaka biya.
Aɗaba haik kǝ nǝghǝgaakanǝghǝg kǝ iitǝra,

content: Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Mbats nǝghamakai kǝ garavǝn biya? Am da nǝghǝgaaka ndar kaci kǝ kyalǝmani?
Dadda riigna, ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl wa riig nǝ iina.
Hulfǝn ɓalal da tǝ ɗuulǝna, iitǝr garava lii cinngaracinng kǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla. Cinngara ba nǝ iitǝra, kaa sagau kǝ Shatanah hutsdan kǝ ǝlbǝgǝn riiyava ma rǝviɗ ma huɗaatǝrna.
Band kwah dlaɓ hulfǝn ɓalal dat caccahǝlawǝna, iin garava lii bad cinngacinngaatǝr kǝ ǝlbǝgǝna, kaa dlǝghgadlǝgh kǝ iitǝr bad ǝrviɗ ma huɗ palla.
Aɗaba ar maay tsau dǝ tlali biya, zǝlarmai vaivai biya. Akwama ciyitciig dlaɗ mbakyarvad ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla, bat watswatsǝr kaa gwiya damma haal kǝ iitǝra
Hulfi ɓalal damma takka, iin garava uudahi cinngaracinng kǝ ǝlbǝgiina.
Bakǝva kwaha kǝmma dǝga duniya, ard naa hyahha, ard kǝmma kyalǝma dǝgitaha, dagha damma ǝrviɗ ma huɗɗaatǝr tsatǝrvatsǝg kǝ ghubarg ba kwal yiiga kǝ zǝra.

Hulfǝn ɓalal da tǝ haay marawna, iin garava lii cinngaracinng kǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla, ar dlǝghan, kaa ɓagaan iitǝr kǝ tlǝr dǝ vakaiya, kaa tlǝknatlǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ yu tuuk vakaiya kyalǝm kul hǝkǝrɗ-kul hǝkǝrɗ, kwatlǝrǝn kul ǝngkwah ǝngkwaha, kyalǝm dlaɓa zǝr dǝrmǝk-dǝrmǝka.”
Garava kaara jahuramba
Am Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Am sagau dǝ kaara jahuramb am humbara kǝ taas nii? Nii am fǝg mazha ngyil kǝ piin hii? Abi am hǝrtǝg tǝ dǝga hǝrtǝggaan nǝ uuram kǝ kaara jahuramb?
Maay dǝgiti shǝɓashǝɓan kwa da sǝrvaaka biya. Dlaɓa maay nǝ dǝga gǝlgǝli kwada maay sagal dat ɓalaɓal biya.
Baɗǝm dadda kwad dǝ hyǝmmiya cinngaana, aa cinngacinnga.”
Amaa taa kǝ iitǝr dlaɓa, “Cinngamcinng ba maraw dǝgiya” “Darami agha kurǝg nǝng dǝ vakaiya, da kurak dǝ vakai nǝ uuda, da fǝkarna nǝ uuda.
Baɗǝm dadda kwa dǝ dǝgita, fǝvarnaafǝga, kwa maay nǝ dǝgaan biya, aanji hǝɗikǝnǝn vakaana da kǝsvarǝvkǝsǝga.”
Garava hulfi fǝtsalfǝtsǝga
Kaa za vuukw kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Band kwan nǝ ndzǝgana tlǝkǝsǝra Daadamazhigǝla. Band uudi riiya hulf ma guhaana.
Tǝhala hǝngngaha, kaa fǝtsǝgalfǝtsǝg kǝ hulfǝn ghubarana, sǝrghai nǝ uuda nǝ iin kǝ dǝgiti ɓagavanǝn biya.
Haay sagal dǝ dǝgwaiya bad ghǝraana, ba zǝngwa ɓagga kǝ ghuuva, kaa ɓa ghǝra, tǝhala kwah kaa dǝg kǝ zǝr tǝ vakaiya
Ma tǝhaltǝhǝg nǝ dǝgwaiya, kaa kǝssant kǝ iin kǝ hǝvva kiyava ghudgaana, aɗaba ɓagaaɓag sarta ghudgaana.”
Garava hulfa Mastad
Kaa gwiya tagaan kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Kiyam da kurǝg dau kǝ tlǝkǝssǝra Daadamazhigǝli? Nii kiyam da gǝrǝg dǝ kwar kǝ garav kǝ ndzǝganani?
Da band dzakǝva hulfa zǝra mastad kwa iin wa mishshish ma hulfaha baɗǝm kwa riiyav damma haaya.
Bakǝva kwaha, akwama riyavariiga, ghubarǝg juujig kǝ kyalǝma uufahi ma ɗyaghaara guha, dǝvahaan ɓa ba maandala, baz ɗiikah ar tsug ma shǝɗkwaana.”
Tagatǝr dǝ garav nǝ Yesu kǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla ba ɗyak, kalkal dǝ ghaala nǝghǝgaakanǝghǝgaatǝra
Maay nǝ dǝgiti tagatǝra nǝ iin kwal garav biya. Sarti ar ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaan ba davaatǝra, tagtǝr ba tǝ ɓalaɓal kǝ dǝgitaha.
Caggharaacag Yesu kǝ gyi kǝ kalangasa
Ba daghuvalaa nǝ iina, hǝrzǝt ba faci kǝ ɓǝla daaya, am Yesu taa kǝ mbǝzahaana, “Jiyam da tǝ kwah kǝ ghyabba yuwa haiya”
Kaa ɗugarsɗuug kǝ iitǝr kǝ dzahava uudaha, kaa dagal kǝ iitǝr ma pɛrrayiwiin band ndzǝganaani ndza ma vakai nǝ iina. Mǝng dlaɓ kyalma pɛrra yuwah ǝmtaɗ dǝ iitǝra.
Kaa cigǝtciig kǝ kalangasa, fǝgharaafǝg baz yu ciya damma zhigǝla, dlaɓa kaa tsǝgaan kǝ iin kǝ pɛrra yuwa, kaa ghubǝɗa saas kǝ yu samma vakaiya hǝrz pɛrra yuwǝn kǝ righǝgga.
Ndza hǝnna haar nǝ Yesu ma hala pɛra yuwa, ɓǝla kǝ ghǝraan tǝ dǝga ɓǝla ghǝra. Ar ciyant mbǝrzahaana, am nǝ iitǝra, “Dadda tsaga dǝgita, wa kiyam ruuga, kats maay lambagh biya?”
Kaa ciig kǝ Yesu cagara kǝ gyi kǝ fǝɗa, amaa taa kǝ yuwa haiyina, “Ɗew amǝnga! Ndzandzǝgga!” Kaa ghacigaghacig kǝ fǝɗa, baɗǝm vaka ndzaandzǝg ba ɗewwa.
Amaa taa kǝ mbǝzahaana, “Aujilbǝg kǝskuram gǝdzǝg ndǝkwani? Gwastǝn am maay dǝ fadghǝr biya?”
Kaa gǝdzǝgǝtdzǝg kǝ iitǝr ba vaivaiya, am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ ghǝrahaatǝra, “War wan kǝ uudi? Baz fǝɗa ar dǝ yu ndakwani ar cinngarnucinngi?”
